topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I can't believe it. I walk into the gallery, expecting the usual hum of quiet admiration, but something feels off. My paintings, those silent companions that have kept me company through countless nights, are different. I step closer, and the details blur, then sharpen painfully. Someone has tattooed my work, etched into the very fabric of the canvas. The colors seem twisted, the lines jagged and intrusive, as if theses pieces are now marked with a permanence I never intended. I want to reach out, to smooth over the harsh lines, but my hands stay by my sides, useless. The familiar walls of the gallery seem to close in, the air thick and heavy. I need to leave, to breathe, but my feet feel rooted, unwilling to carry me away from this strange, altered reality.
